factual_claims.claim: Momentum recovered in the second half of the year: fourth-quarter net new ARR was DKK 3.1M, compared with DKK 1.8M in the corresponding quarter of 2024, although full-year net new ARR declined to DKK 7.5M from DKK 8.3M.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development section states 'We ended the year with a strong Q4 2025, with net new ARR of DKK 3.1M, compared to DKK 1.8M in the corresponding quarter in 2024... For the full year 2025, Impero's net new ARR was DKK 7.5M compared to net new ARR of DKK 8.3M in the full year 2024'

factual_claims.claim: Customer numbers exceeded 200 after 26 new customer wins.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management commentary states 'By the end of 2025, we reached a significant milestone as our customer base surpassed 200 customers... During the year, we welcomed 26 new customers'

factual_claims.claim: Customer retention remained strong, with churn at 1% versus 2% in 2024 and net revenue retention at 106% versus 108%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development section states 'In 2025, we had an exceptionally low churn rate of only 1%... Net Revenue Retention Rate (NRR) ended at 106% in 2025, slightly lower than 108% in 2024'

factual_claims.claim: Gross uplift from existing customers was 12%, and average ARR per account increased 8% to DKK 228T.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development section states 'Net uplift of 7% was driven by a strong gross uplift to existing customers of DKK 4.5M, corresponding to 12%... We have lifted the Average ARR per Account (ARPA) to a record high level of DKK 228T by the end of 2025'

factual_claims.claim: However, customer acquisition cost rose to DKK 371T from DKK 222T, and CAC payback increased to 22 months from 15 months, reflecting higher lead-generation spending and fewer new customers.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: SaaS metrics table shows CAC of DKK 371T vs DKK 222T. ARR development section states 'Towards the end 2025, we improved our CAC payback months to 22 months compared to a higher level earlier in 2025... both the customer acquisition cost (CAC) of DKK 371T in 2025 and the CAC payback are higher than in 2024'

factual_claims.claim: Growth was led by the DACH region, where ARR grew 26%, and Denmark, where it grew 22%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development section states 'In Denmark, we increased net new ARR by a growth rate of 22% YoY... Our second core market, the DACH region, led the growth with 26% growth YoY in 2025'

factual_claims.claim: Each market represented approximately 44% of total ARR at year-end.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development section states 'In Denmark... total ARR of DKK 20.5M... Danish market now constitutes 44% of Impero's total ARR... DACH region closed the year with a total ARR of DKK 20.1M, corresponding to 44% of Impero's total ARR'

factual_claims.claim: ARR from other markets declined 6% to DKK 5.5M, primarily because of contraction in the UK.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development section states 'ARR from other markets declined to DKK 5.5M by the end of the year, corresponding to -6% YoY in 2025, primarily explained by a larger contraction in the UK'

factual_claims.claim: Product development advanced through the launch of the Control Testing module, initial AI features, and expanded German partner coverage.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow improved operationally, with cash flow from ordinary operating activities improving to negative DKK 1.3M from negative DKK 4.3M.

factual_claims.claim: Cash ended at DKK 18.9M after a DKK 15M directed issue and warrant exercises, while equity increased to DKK 15.4M from DKK 6.2M.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Balance sheet shows cash of DKK 18,851T (18.851M) vs DKK 9,798T (9.798M) in 2024. Shareholder information states 'Impero successfully raised DKK 15M in a private placement in December 2025... As of 31 December 2025, Impero's equity stood at DKK 15.4M'

factual_claims.claim: For 2026, Impero expects ARR of DKK 53–57M and EBITDA between negative DKK 2M and positive DKK 1M.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Guidance for 2026 section states 'By the end of 2026, Impero expects Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) to reach between DKK 53M and 57M... For 2026, EBITDA is expected to be in the range of DKK -2M to +1M'

factual_claims.claim: Commercial investment will accelerate, and the ambition of recurring positive cash flow before the end of 2026 has been deferred.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Strategy update states 'Impero has deferred its ambition of achieving positive cash flow on a recurring basis before the end of 2026... New investments are expected to take place in 2026 and are centered around the commercial organization'
